decisions.statement: A color a design token has is reached by name rather than written out again.
The palette's own home writes its colors out and is judged by nothing here.
This check's own home writes the grants out and is judged by nothing here.
A page states a value and dresses nothing.
A color worked out from a token by relative color syntax is taken from a token.
An achromatic color at an alpha is a shadow rather than a shade of the palette.
An achromatic color among the other words of one value is let through.
A generated file is judged where its generator sits rather than where that file lands.
A string that is one color on its own is judged wherever that string sits.
A color inside a utility class's bracketed value is judged as any color is.
A grant names one file and the values Alan let that file have.
Each value a grant names has a reason.
A grant reaches only the file the grant names and only the values the grant names.

definition: the check refusing a color written out rather than taken from a design token
